description: Land Acquisition - Embalapola, Narammala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Pelawatta, Narammala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Ahugoda, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for the acquisition of multiple land lots for public purposes, including specific descriptions of boundaries, extents, and locations of the lands. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena) making the declaration, this is incidental to the core land-related content. The document focuses exclusively on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
